$description: The platform-neutral contract every generator (Web now, Android/iOS later) must satisfy. Restates design-system/platform-mapping.md's conventions in a form the design-to-code pipeline itself can be validated against. Android and iOS are NOT implemented this phase — this file only makes the shared JSON structurally suitable for them later.

pipeline.diagram: Shared JSON (design-to-code/shared/*.json, design-to-code/screens/*.json, design-to-code/patterns/*.json) -> Web generator (tools/design-to-code/generate.js) -> [Android generator later] -> [iOS generator later]
pipeline.rule: A generator READS shared JSON and WRITES platform-specific generated artifacts. A generator never writes back into shared/screens/patterns JSON, and a generated artifact is never hand-edited — regenerate from source instead.

existingWebTokenPipeline.role: Pre-existing, NOT replaced. Reads design-system/design-tokens.json + themes/*.json directly and writes web/styles/tokens.css, web/styles/tailwind-theme.css, web/src/lib/design-tokens.generated.ts. This design-to-code pipeline is a SEPARATE, ADDITIONAL generator for the layers token-pipeline does not cover (component recipes, navigation/shell rules, artwork rules, screen-to-route mapping) — it does not duplicate or conflict with token-pipeline's output.
existingWebTokenPipeline.decisionReference: execution/DECISIONS_LOG.md D35 (token-pipeline's own plain-Node, no-external-dependency precedent, followed by tools/design-to-code/ for the same reason).

consumes: design-to-code/screens/*.json (for route/shell mapping only, not for visual re-generation of full pages)
web.generatesInto: web/src/lib/design-to-code.generated.ts (typed constants: component recipe names, navigation shell rules, artwork motif mapping, responsive breakpoint re-export for JS-side consumers that can't read a CSS var)
web.colorConvention: CSS custom property, kebab-case, theme-scoped via [data-theme] — already generated by tools/token-pipeline/generate.js; this pipeline's TS constants REFERENCE the same var names, never redefine them.
web.doesNotGenerate: Raw CSS custom properties for tokens — that remains token-pipeline's job. This pipeline generates the layer ABOVE raw tokens: named recipes and structural constants.

android.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — mapping only, for future readiness.
android.wouldGenerateInto: android/app/src/main/java/.../design/MentoraTokens.kt (or equivalent) — a MentoraTheme Compose theme object exposing colors/typography/spacing/shape/elevation via CompositionLocal, plus component-recipe data classes mirroring shared/components.json's structure 1:1.
readinessNotes: shared/tokens.json's dot-path names already match platform-mapping.md's documented Android naming convention 1:1 — a generator only needs a dot-path -> camelCase transform, already implemented once in tools/token-pipeline/generate.js's kebabPath()/camelToKebabSegment() helpers (inverse direction needed for Android/iOS, not yet written).

shared/components.json's token references (e.g. "color.brand.primary") resolve identically regardless of target platform — no Android-specific re-authoring of component recipes is anticipated, only a new renderer for the same recipe data.

shared/navigation.json's shell definitions are Web-shaped (Sidebar/Navbar) since Instructor/Admin are Web-only by product design (product/USER_ROLES.md) — an Android app (Student-only surfaces) would consume shared/navigation.json#/shells/coursePlayerShell and a new, not-yet-specified MobileBottomNavigation-driven shell, not Sidebar/Navbar.

ios.status: NOT IMPLEMENTED — mapping only, for future readiness.
ios.wouldGenerateInto: ios/Mentora/Design/MentoraTokens.swift + a Color Set asset catalog (Any/Dark appearances) generated from shared/tokens.json#/color/semantic — mirrors design-system/platform-mapping.md § 9's suggested repository structure.
readinessNotes: Typography must wrap each token in a Dynamic-Type-aware Font style per shared/tokens.json#/units — the shared JSON already carries the base fontSize/lineHeight numbers a SwiftUI generator needs; it does not yet carry an explicit Dynamic-Type category mapping (inferred to be a straightforward relative-scale wrap, not a new value set).

shared/components.json's `select` recipe explicitly maps to a Menu/Picker-style SwiftUI control (design-system/COMPONENTS.md § Select, Native mapping) — already documented, no additional shared-JSON change needed to support it later.

shared/artwork.json's motif system is platform-agnostic (gradient + icon + chip composition) and requires no iOS-specific restructuring — only a new SwiftUI view implementing the same composition recipe.

generatorFailureContract.rule: Generation MUST fail loudly (non-zero exit, printed reason) rather than emit partial/guessed output when: a screen references a component name absent from shared/components.json; a component/screen references a token dot-path absent from shared/tokens.json (or shared/typography|spacing|shape|elevation.json); two screens declare the same screenId; a pattern is referenced by a screen but does not exist under design-to-code/patterns/.
generatorFailureContract.implementedBy: tools/design-to-code/validate.js — see design-to-code/validation/EXTRACTION_REPORT.md and MAPPING_REPORT.md for what it actually checks and found.
